title: Gemini PolicyPal — AI-Powered Insurance Policy Analyzer
text:
Insurance policy documents are often long, complex, and difficult to interpret. Users struggle to quickly understand coverage details, identify exclusions, or compare multiple policies. Traditional keyword search is insufficient for navigating unstructured legal text, and manual comparison is time-consuming and error-prone.
This creates a need for an intelligent system that can: - Understand policy documents semantically
- Answer user questions accurately
- Compare multiple policies in a structured way

title: Gemini PolicyPal — AI-Powered Insurance Policy Analyzer
text:
Insurance policy documents are often long, complex, and difficult to interpret. Users struggle to quickly understand coverage details, identify exclusions, or compare multiple policies. Traditional keyword search is insufficient for navigating unstructured legal text, and manual comparison is time-consuming and error-prone.
This creates a need for an intelligent system that can: - Understand policy documents semantically
- Answer user questions accurately
- Compare multiple policies in a structured way

title: Gemini PolicyPal — AI-Powered Insurance Policy Analyzer
text:
⚙️ My Approach
To address this problem, I built an end-to-end AI system based on a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline.

🔍 Document Processing

Parsed uploaded insurance documents (PDF/text)
Split documents into structured chunks
Cleaned and standardized text for downstream processing



🧠 Semantic Retrieval

Generated embeddings for each chunk

Implemented similarity-based retrieval to identify relevant content

Enabled context-aware search beyond keyword matching



🤖 RAG Question Answering

Retrieved top relevant chunks

Constructed grounded prompts for LLM

Generated answers strictly based on source content to reduce hallucination



⚖️ Policy Comparison System

Designed a multi-document comparison module

Enabled side-by-side analysis of Policy A vs Policy B

Highlighted differences in coverage, exclusions, and conditions



💻 User Interface

Built an interactive Streamlit app

Supported multi-file upload

Enabled real-time question answering and comparison

title: Gemini PolicyPal — AI-Powered Insurance Policy Analyzer
text:
📊 Key Results

Successfully built a working end-to-end AI system integrating document parsing, retrieval, and LLM generation

Improved information retrieval accuracy compared to keyword-based approaches

Enabled structured comparison of complex policy documents

Delivered an interactive user experience for real-time document analysis

title: Gemini PolicyPal — AI-Powered Insurance Policy Analyzer
text:
💡 Reflections

What I Learned

RAG pipelines are highly effective for grounding LLM responses in real data

Embedding-based retrieval significantly improves understanding of unstructured text

Designing reliable AI systems requires controlling hallucination and enforcing structure



Limitations

Performance depends on document quality and formatting

Long documents may require more advanced chunking strategies

No domain-specific fine-tuning (e.g., insurance-specific models)



Next Steps

Add citation highlighting (show exact source location)

Improve comparison visualization (UI enhancement)

Explore domain-specific embeddings for higher accuracy
